paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a, "Pharoah kiang ah hoh inla, akiang ah hichi in chi in ‘Toupa’n hichi in achi, ka nna ahon sepsak theihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.'
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Amau paisak na nialleh, ngai in, ukengte in na gam tengteng ka gawt ding hi.
english: If you refuse to let them go, behold, I will plague all your borders with frogs.

paite: Lui in ukeng atam a tam hon suahkhe ding ua, huaite ahong paitou ding ua, na inn ah ahong lut ding ua, na lupna dantan sung ah, na lupna tung ah, na sikhate inn ah, na mite tung ah, na thuk ah leh na tangbuang bawlna ah ahong om ding uh.
english: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and into the house of your servants, and on your people, and into your ovens, and into your kneading troughs.

paite: Ukengte nang tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah ahong kaltou ding uhi," chi in.
english: The frogs shall come up both on you, and on your people, and on all your servants.”’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, luinak neite tung leh luite tung leh tuichinte tung ah na chiangkhun toh na khut lik inla, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte hon paitousak in, chi in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your hand with your rod over the rivers, over the streams, and over the pools, and cause frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.’”

paite: Aaron in Aigupta luite tung ah akhut alik a; ukengte ahong paitou ua, Aigupta gamsung atuamta uhi.
english: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

paite: Huchi mah bang in mitkhialdawi tawite'n amitkhialdawi un ahih ua, Aigupta gam tung ah ukengte ahon latou uhi.
english: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments, and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

paite: Huaitak in Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Kei leh ka mite a pan ukengte alakmang theihna ding in, TOUPA ngen un. TOUPA kiang a kithoihna abawltheihna ding un, mite ka paisak ding," achi hi.
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, “Entreat Yahweh, that he take away the frogs from me and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may sacrifice to Yahweh.”

paite: Mosi in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka tung ah ki-uangsak in; nang a ding leh na sikhate a ding leh na mite a ding leh nang leh na innte a pan, tui a a-omtheihna ding ua ukengte lakmangna dia chikchiang a hon ngetsak ding ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Moses said to Pharaoh, “I give you the honor of setting the time that I should pray for you, and for your servants, and for your people, that the frogs be destroyed from you and your houses, and remain in the river only.”

paite: Ama'n, "Zingchiang in," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na thu bang hi hen. TOUPA ka Pathian bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
english: Pharaoh said, “Tomorrow.” Moses said, “Let it be according to your word, that you may know that there is no one like Yahweh our God.

paite: Nang leh na innte uh leh na sikhate leh na mite a pan ukengte apawtkhe ding ua; lui kia ah a-omta ding uh," achi hi.
english: The frogs shall depart from you, and from your houses, and from your servants, and from your people. They shall remain in the river only.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi leh Aaron apaikhia ua; Pharaoh gawtna ding a ukengte akoih tungtang ah TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh, and Moses cried to Yahweh concerning the frogs which he had brought on Pharaoh.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi thu bang in ahihta a; innte leh khuate a pan leh loute a pan ukengte asita uhi.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the courts, and out of the fields.

paite: Huchi in akaikhawm ua, avum ua, gam a-uihta hi.
english: They gathered them together in heaps, and the land stank.

paite: Himahleh Pharaoh in atung azangta chih atheih in, alungtang akhauhsak a; amaute angaikhe kei; TOUPA gen bang in.
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron kiang ah, na chiangkhun lik inla, gam a leivui sat in, Aigupta gam pumpi a hik ahong omtheihna ding un, chi in,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.’”

paite: Huchibang in ahih ua; Aaron in achiangkhun toh akhut alik a, lei a leivui asat a, mi tung leh sa tung ah hik ahong omta a; gam a leivui teng Aigupta gam pumpi ah hik ahong suak vekta hi.
english: They did so; and Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and struck the dust of the earth, and there were lice on man, and on animal; all the dust of the earth became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

paite: Mitkhialdawi tawite'n leng amitkhialdawi un hikte omsak ding in huchibang in ahih ua, himahleh ahihthei kei uh. Huchi in mi tung leh sa tung ah hik a-omta hi.
english: The magicians tried with their enchantments to produce lice, but they couldn’t. There were lice on man, and on animal.

paite: Huaitak in mitkhialdawi tawite'n Pharaoh kiang ah, "Hiai Pathian khutzung ahi," achi uhi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, TOUPA'N achih bang in amau angaikhe kei hi.
english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh in. Ngai in, tuilam zuan a, ahong paikhiak in akiang ah, 'Hichibang in TOUPA'n achi, ka nna aseptheihna ding un, ka mite paisak in.
heading: Thouhonpite
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; behold, he comes out to the water; and tell him, ‘This is what Yahweh says, “Let my people go, that they may serve me.

paite: Huchi lou a, ka mite na paisak keileh, ngai in, na tung ah leh na sikhate tung ah leh na mite tung ah leh na insung ah thouhonpi ka sawl ding. Huchi in Aiguptate innte thouhonpi in adim ding, a-omna lei uh toh.
english: Else, if you will not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies on you, and on your servants, and on your people, and into your houses. The houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground they are on.

paite: Huai ni in ka mite tenna, Goshen gam ka satkhen ding, huai a thouhonpi a-omlouhna ding in; huchi a gamsung ah kei TOUPA ka hi chih na theihna ding in.
english: I will set apart in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there, to the end you may know that I am Yahweh on the earth.

paite: Ka mite leh na mite kikal ah kikhenna ka koih ding. Zingchiang in hiai chiamtehna a-om ding hi,' " achi hi.
english: I will put a division between my people and your people. This sign shall happen by tomorrow.”’”

paite: Huchibang in TOUPA'N ahih a; Pharaoh insung leh asikhate insung leh Aigupta gam tengteng ah, thouhonpi thupitak ahong omta a; thouhonpi ziak in gam asegawp hi.
english: Yahweh did so; and there came grievous swarms of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants’ houses. In all the land of Egypt the land was corrupted by reason of the swarms of flies.

paite: Pharaoh in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Pai unla, gamsung ah na Pathian kiang uah kithoihun." achi hi.
english: Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, “Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!”

paite: Himahleh Mosi in, "Huchibang a hih adik kei ding. TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hih ziak un. Ngai in, amuh ua Aiguptate zakdah kithoihna lan ding ka hi uh maw, suang in ahon deng kei ding ua hia?
english: Moses said, “It isn’t appropriate to do so; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to Yahweh our God. Behold, if we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, won’t they stone us?

paite: Gamdai ah ni thum lam ah ka pai ding uh; ahon thupiak ding bang a TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang a kithoihna bawl ding in," achi hi.
english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, as he shall command us.”

paite: Huan Pharaoh in, "Gamdai a TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang a na kithoihtheihna ding un ka hon paisak ding. Gamlapi ah pai kei peuh le uchin. Kei a ding in hon ngetsak in," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “I will let you go, that you may sacrifice to Yahweh your God in the wilderness, only you shall not go very far away. Pray for me.”

paite: Huan Mosi in, “Ngai in, nang a pan ka paikhe dia, Pharaoh a pan, na sikhate a pan, na mite a pan zingchiang a thouhonpi apaimang theihna ding in TOUPA ka ngen ding. Himahleh TOUPA kiang a kithoih dia amite paisak ding in lepchiahtak in Pharaoh gamta nawn kei hen," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Behold, I am going out from you. I will pray to Yahweh that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, tomorrow; only don’t let Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in Pharaoh a pan Mosi apawtkhia a, TOUPA angenta hi.
english: Moses went out from Pharaoh, and prayed to Yahweh.

paite: Huan Mosi thu bang in TOUPA'N ahihta a; Pharaoh a pan leh asikhate a pan thouhonpi alamangta a; khat lel leng a-om nawnta kei hi.
english: Yahweh did according to the word of Moses, and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people. There remained not one.

paite: Himahleh hiai hun in leng Pharaoh in alungtang akhauhsak a, mite apaisak nuam tuan kei hi.
english: Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.
